summary: Prepare daemon readers for private thread routing

replay.detail: The registry learns four optional message routing fields. Previously held signed messages can enter the graph when normal schema retry runs.

schema.detail: SQLite reader floor advances automatically to 21. Builds supporting version 20 refuse the upgraded database before serving any data.

rules.detail: Checkpoint and replication rules retain the exact original claim data.

compatibility.detail: Generic claims and history omit signed messages containing thread routing. Generic events and status keep ordinary message data and omit those relations. Ordinary message views still render the message. Ordinary graph and shard writes reserve all four fields.

downtime.detail: The reader floor is installed during normal daemon startup.

manual.detail: Upgrade and verify readers before enabling a separately reviewed thread writer rollout.

recovery.detail: Recovery uses a version-21-capable reader. Preserve a pre-upgrade archive if a version-20 rollback is needed before enabling thread writes.
